candidates.snippet: Russia is ready to resume trilateral talks involving Ukraine, the US and Russia in the first half of November, according to Putin’s representative Ushakov.

Monitoring channels report that a Russian Su-30SM has crashed in the Kaliningrad region. Unfortunately, the pilots survived. According to research by RUSI and CSIS, Russian Su-30SMs have been using Kh-31P and Kh-58 anti-radiation missiles to target Ukrainian air defense radar htt
